title: Figure 6: Wigner function of a single photon, viewed from above and below
description: Two 3D mesh surface plots over q and p axes from -2 to 2, with vertical scale from -0.3 to 0.1, showing a ring-shaped ridge with a central dip that dips below zero. Caption reads "Figure 6. Wigner Function of a Single Photon. The figure shows the experimentally reconstructed Wigner function as seen from above (top) and from below (bottom)." The caption notes negative "probabilities" near the origin demonstrate the nonclassical aspect of photons.
